summary.en: A wipe line brings the name, the install line typing, the address and the published page beside the seam; on the last bar the seam closes and the caret waits.
summary.zh: 一道擦除线带来名字、逐字打出的安装命令、网址和接缝旁已发布的页面；最后一小节接缝合上，光标停着等。

fits: The close of a split film.
notFor: A logo card; a QR end card.

intent.en: What to type to get it, beside where it is published; then the seam leaves.
intent.zh: 告诉人怎么装、去哪里看；然后接缝离开。

content.en: The name (≤ 16 characters), the install command (≤ 44), the address (≤ 44), a glance line (≤ 6 words), the published page.
content.zh: 名字（≤ 8 字）、安装命令（≤ 44 字符）、网址（≤ 44 字符）、一行扫读（≤ 14 字）、已发布的页面。

en: Hold the address at least 3 s.

fits: any film whose input maps line by line to an output

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
